# Recorded 14 Nov 2026 (HI-3206) on Windows 11 Pro 10.0.26200 with Windows Sandbox installed:

WindowsSandboxServer.exe        C:\Users\<user>\AppData\Local\Microsoft\WindowsApps\WindowsSandboxServer.exe
